assertion.statement: For the original principally polarized QM surface A/K in the six-contact construction, one finite Galois field L contains K, defines all ordered Hom groups between its conjugates, has degree at most D and is unramified outside T; the full geometric endomorphism algebra of A is B or M2(k) for an imaginary quadratic k.
assertion.objects: The original A, W0=Res_(K/Q) A and its actual integral endomorphism lattice; the same geometric conjugates and original principal polarization.
assertion.hypotheses: The original-datum construction supplies K/Q normal of degree<=F0=324!, A/K good outside S, K unramified outside T=S union supp(M_S(u)), and common polarized geometric point; the retained published Hodge/algebraicity and good-reduction Tate inputs apply.
assertion.quantifiers: Every rational u outside the six contacts and allowed S; all conjugates and all ordered pairs of them; every prime outside T.
assertion.parameter_range: Characteristic zero, dimension A=2, dim W0=2[K:Q]; arbitrary finite rank r of End(W0), not only rank4.
assertion.uniformity: One field L simultaneously defines the full Hom collection; its bound is uniform in u once F0 is fixed.
assertion.normalizations: Full geometric endomorphisms and integral Betti lattice; action on End(W0) rather than a chosen equivariant labeling of conjugates. Betti/Tate comparison is not claimed Galois equivariant.
assertion.exceptional_cases: Every residue prime is covered by choosing an auxiliary Tate prime different from it. The torsion-free mod3 kernel proof applies to arbitrary r. CM and non-CM outcomes are separated; no replacement isogenous A is substituted.
assertion.limit_order: Construct W0 and its finite Galois action first, kill that action by its mod3 kernel, then descend block Hom maps and identify full Hodge endomorphisms.

assertion.statement: For the actual odd-prime curve E_l and its rational normalized newform f, every q not dividing N has a_q(f)=q+1-#E_l(F_q), and phi=alpha q_f:J0(N) to E_l satisfies phi T_q=[a_q(f)]phi with the unaveraged geometric neighbor correspondence; pi(x)=phi([x]-[infinity]) has pi(infinity)=0.
assertion.objects: The same E_l, conductor N, rational coefficient newform f, Shimura quotient q_f:J0(N) to A_f, and Q-isogeny alpha:A_f to E_l.
assertion.hypotheses: The published newform input supplies normalized integral weight-two f and its trace comparison outside 2N. Shimura supplies the rational elliptic quotient and the correspondence action. Faltings supplies the same-Q isogeny from almost-all equal Euler factors. The actual model has discriminant 2304*l^6 with l odd.
assertion.quantifiers: Every prime q not dividing N and every point x of X0(N) in the geometric neighbor correspondence.
assertion.parameter_range: Fixed E_l and its actual conductor N; l is odd. No bad-prime trace assertion is imported.
assertion.uniformity: The same quotient and isogeny serve all good primes; no averaging or q-dependent rescaling is introduced.
assertion.constants: v2(Delta)=8 modulo12 implies 2 divides N; the correspondence has q+1 branches and T_q[infinity]=(q+1)[infinity].
assertion.normalizations: a_1(f)=1; pullback operator q*f(qz)+(1/q)*sum_j f((z+j)/q), coefficient a_(qn)+q*a_(n/q); the unital rational coefficient action is integer multiplication.
assertion.exceptional_cases: At level primes only the U_p eigenoperator statement is retained, not a bad-prime trace formula. a_q=0 causes no division. No Manin constant, integral homology index, Atkin-Lehner identity, local extension or reduction is asserted.
assertion.limit_order: Choose f and its quotient, compare almost-all Euler factors to obtain alpha over Q, check 2|N, identify the unaveraged good-prime correspondence, and then compose alpha q_f and subtract the fixed cusp.

use.reason: The explicit current connecting derivation checks the even conductor, branch operator, symmetry and cusp cancellation before transferring the quotient identity by the Q-isogeny.

assertion.objects: The same abelian surface A over the finite number field F of actual Tate restriction, and an F-defined polarization lambda:A->A^dual.

assertion.uniformity: The construction applies to this original A and F; it asserts no uniform field degree and makes no replacement of the family.

assertion.limit_order: Take compatible prime-power torsion pairings, pass to Tate modules, tensor with Q_5, and compose with the isogeny lambda.
